title: XIA Nightly Processor configuration
description: Revalidates queued Jira issues for pending XIA archive requests and bulk-moves eligible ones into the Jira XIA project.

JIRA_BASE_URL.title: Jira base URL:
JIRA_BASE_URL.description: Jira API gateway base URL, e.g. https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/{cloud_id}

#jira_api_token.title: Jira API token:
#jira_api_token.description: Service account API token, sent as a Bearer token. Obtain it from Atlassian admin.atlassian.com service account settings.

debug.title: Enable Debug Logging:
debug.description: If true, enables verbose debug logging in the job output.
